en: It is not a contract sitting in a drawer, but an order that runs as a system, aims at an economic result and seems natural because it is repeated so often. It does not only announce rules. It classifies, records, recommends, blocks, restricts and changes the very environment in which you try to use what you bought. And whenever we talk about the platform that governs the place, we are talking about this law. The name comes from an old expression, the law merchant, used for the rules that traders created among themselves, without depending on the law of any country. The difference is that here the center is not the practice of many traders. It is a single company, which controls the front door, the way you understand what happens and the conditions under which you can use what is yours.

The platform need not be treated as a State for its powers to be subject to legal constraint, and containment does not require dissolving the private nature of the relationship or constitutionalizing every private dispute, because it is aimed at certain powers exercised through architecture, information and enforcement at scale. Good faith does not stop the freedom to shape the bond from existing, only from becoming private sovereignty. In the Vanguard case, the kernel anti-cheat is not automatically unlawful, the legitimacy of fighting cheating still stands, and what is refused is only the legal immunization of deep, persistent and opaque technical governance over someone else's machine. This is the foundation on which platform governance becomes legally controllable, and the outcome of each case depends on the criteria of the chapters on open auditability, functional value equivalence and the unlawful act of architecture.

The three order different things, the reading of a conflict, the parameters and the qualification, and they converge at the point that matters for the remedy. In the second, evidence comes after abusive teleology, and restoration follows the same order when what precedes it is listed. In the first, teleology does not appear as a step of its own, because there it appears among the legitimacy filters that operate on the base formed by the object and the vulnerability, and evidence is the third step. In the framework, each situation sets out the minimum evidence before the qualification and the consequence. In none of the three does the consequence come before the evidence.
